mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to safety, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% in the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from their 3-month prior levels, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% for 3 consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates strengthening labor market conditions, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS has increased over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 in a 3-month window, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, which results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline from their 3-month prior levels, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion (when housing starts exceed 1500 thousand units and retail sales exceed 750 billion dollars), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to overvaluation and impending policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST exceeds 1500 and RSAFS exceeds 750, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.02.
